page.content:
Crown-mad wizard who kidnaps princesses and writes fanfiction.

How Ice King connects

  • Character: Simon Petrikov — Simon Petrikov is the man the Ice King used to be.
  • Faction: Ice Kingdom — The Ice King rules the Ice Kingdom.
  • Item: Ice Crown — The Ice King is the crown's worn-down wearer.
  • Series: Fionna and Cake — Fionna and Cake began as the Ice King's fanfiction.
  • Character: Princess Bubblegum — The Ice King's early bit is kidnapping princesses, especially Bubblegum.

What is Ice King?

The Ice King is the lonely wizard of ice magic, comic villain and tragic husk, later revealed as Simon Petrikov worn down by the crown.

Key threads lead to Simon Petrikov, Ice Kingdom, Ice Crown, Fionna and Cake and Princess Bubblegum.
